Page 130 Cont.
Mar. 7th Hanna Leen - 46 - nerve-break has husband and four children and a nephew of her husbands.
8 Mrs. Mary Valente - 1073 Meldrum - phone Melrose 3536 - wants woman to be in home with two small children - just cook for herself and children while goes out to work. Will pay her wages.
9 E'd Szymazewski - 22 - soldier - serious stomach trouble; though X-ray shows 0
Eulelia Grice - 21 - married in church but now "in-laws" prevent the baby from being baptised ... Enrolled To-day in S. Mass A.
Page 131
Mar. 10th Thomas Devlin - 7 - To-day sick from school two weeks. To-day Dr's have failed to find cause or to decide just what the trouble - En- rolled this p.m. 50c - 14th improved ....
12th Thanks - Mrs. John Shanghssny - called last Thursday - night to en- roll her husband in Ser. Mass Ass'n .... very serious operation sche- duled next a.m. - Kidney was to be removed ... No operation was necess- ary. Instead her husband came home that after-noon. This was the second big favor % phone. Wife comes and enrolled him Today 5.
12 E'd Norrie - 46 - baptist - heart trouble and swolen ankles and legs - thin. Enrolled Today .. ..
Johanna Heffernan - 91 - from Co. Clare Ireland (in St. Martin Parish) has quite lost her speech. Inclined a little to impatience when she finds it necessary to write out what she would like to say: has still a good hand at 91. Enrolled Today.
Baby James Stine - 7 mo. blind ... Drs in Ann Arbor fear cancer - give six months to live .... Enrolled 5.
Page 132 Mar. 10 Mrs. Ida Baker - 33 - in St. Joseph Retr. - nerv. Break - has husband and two children - anxious for her return.
Mr. Jule Dupuis - 78 - throat cancer very threatening .. . from outside Windsor.
13 James Smith - 13 - of Saginaw - 6th grade - experimenting in basement .... whatever it was exploded - blew off three fingers and Drs. say "Only miracle will save his sight" His teacher phones long distance ... Sr. Concepta.
